events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi. This is Maria Alvarez, born 03/14/2027. Please send a refill for my lisinopril.
One moment while I check your details.
Those details did not match a patient record. Please repeat your full name and date of birth.
No. Wait. Not that one. I meant my budesonide inhaler.
I still need to verify you before discussing any medicine. Please tell me your full name and date of birth.
I cannot send a request until the patient is verified. Please tell me your full name and date of birth.
